[[C:Heroic weapons that can be made Sentient]]

enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Insightful Combat Mastery +4: +4 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Rockslide: This weapon stores the power of a volatile rockslide deep within. On hit, there is a chance to do massive bludgeoning damage to your enemy.
Shockwave: On Vorpal, this weapon triggers a Shockwave, striking its target with bludgeoning damage and dealing damage to surrounding enemies.
Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
